corrections.reason: Upstream zh source swaps Advantage and Incapacitated. English canonical XMM says ally is not Incapacitated and baboon has Advantage.
corrections.englishCanonical: The baboon has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the baboon's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
corrections.zhTraditional: 若狒狒的攻擊目標生物 5 呎內至少有一名狒狒未失能的盟友，則狒狒對該生物進行的攻擊檢定具有優勢。
